audit.why: Ranged mage with no dash but a hard anti-dash tool. She wins the poke phase; Aatrox wins the moment he is on top of her with Miasma down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze (R) is 120/100/80 and only stuns enemies facing her. World Ender (120/100/80) is the same cooldown, so the level-6 all-in is decided by whether you turned away from her R.
audit.corrected: Petrifying Gaze (R) stuns only enemies facing her, so turn away as she casts. Miasma (W, 24s at rank 1) grounds your Umbral Dash — leave the cloud before you commit World Ender.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Miasma (W, 24/22/20/18/16) grounds — grounded enemies cannot use movement abilities, so it directly shuts off Umbral Dash (E, 9/8/7/6/5). Twin Fang (E, 0.75s) heals her off poisoned targets, so Grievous Wounds decides long fights.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto her. Infernal Chains (W) drags her back to the centre if she doesn't leave the zone. Miasma (W, 24s at rank 1) grounds you: while you stand in it Umbral Dash is dead, so cross the cloud on foot or wait it out. Petrifying Gaze (R) only stuns you if you are facing her — turn away mid-cast. Twin Fang heals her, so buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Cassiopeia's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (R) stuns only enemies facing her, so turn away as she casts. Miasma (W, 24s at rank 1) grounds your Umbral Dash — leave the cloud before you commit World Ender.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Cassiopeia. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. Vs a ranged laner, save E to close the gap or dodge poke — not for chip damage; you only win once you're on top of him. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive his ultimate — never burn it for a single Q.
